The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Arrianya Bel Iblis]] had a '''family''' that included them and their [[Arriyana and Garm Bel Iblis's daughters|two daughters]]. Arrianya and their daughters were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[bombing of the Treitamma Political Center]] on [[Anchoron]]<ref name="Interlude" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Essential Reader's">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
